summary: Independent research and source evaluation can proceed concurrently.

tasks.title: Develop a research brief
tasks.instructions: Research a question supplied by the user. Deliver a brief in your owned output directory and its required result envelope. If no question has been supplied, block with that reason.
acceptance: The brief answers the supplied question and cites its sources.
The result envelope references the brief and verification evidence.

tasks.title: Assess source quality
tasks.instructions: Independently evaluate relevant source quality for the user-supplied question. Deliver your assessment and required result envelope. Block if the question is missing.
acceptance: The assessment explains source strengths and limitations.
The result envelope references the assessment and verification evidence.
